model: human:gabriel + opengo (glm-5.3-flash), cross-checked against two independent prototype reviews

items.evidence: Labels and dim metadata (CPU/MEMORY/BOT on home, TRACK/SOURCE/LENGTH on music) legible on near-black at both widths; idle gray confined to the footer credit and disabled controls.
Amber on dark everywhere; zero red in any shot; no green (also enforced by tests/test_design_language.py). ONLINE chip is amber, memory bar amber.

Brackets appear only on the NOW PLAYING panel (.is-playing, the playing surface) in desktop-music/mobile-music; nav uses brighten + 1px underline, no brackets; static panels (SERVER, NAVIGATE, LINK, SEARCH, QUEUE) have none.

Boxed titles (01 // SERVER, 02 // QUEUE) align across panels; queue row keeps thumb | index | title | duration+DEL in one row with metadata right (macro-rendered rows match pre-refactor pixels); transport is a segmented bottom strip.

Mobile-music queue row reads as one list row (thumb + 01 second on the first line, 3:00 DEL right-aligned below) after the .row-meta wrap fix; single column, boxed titles and mono identity intact at 375.

Viewport shots show the transport pinned at the bottom above the status strip with nothing covered at rest; main-content padding-bottom (5rem desktop / 10rem mobile) clears the fixed furniture. No cut-off or colliding elements at either width.
Scanline texture perceptible only as faint banding in panel fills; no per-element glow, no badges, no HUD excess in any of the eight shots.
